name: 3-methoxy-N-methylamphetamine
summary: 3-Methoxymethamphetamine, (3-MMA), also known as meta-methoxymethamphetamine (MMMA), is a psychoactive drug of the amphetamine family related to 3-methoxyamphetamine (3-MA or MMA) and to positional isomers like ortho-methoxymethamphetamine (OMMA) and para-methoxymethamphetamine (PMMA). It has been said that virtually nothing is known about the activity of 3-MMA.
